title: Geologic map of the Spring Island quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2001, Geologic map of the Spring Island quadrangle, Beaufort and Jasper Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-140, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Page 1 is the map sheet; pages 2-4 are unrelated symbol-style notes appended to the download (no values taken). Map symbols assigned from description boxes on the page image, flagged inferred. Section A-A' holes read from page-image tiles and checked against colour columns sampled from the PDF; elevations in ft off the feet scale (below-sea-level labels printed without a minus sign; recorded negative). 5-151 and 5-194 continue below the section base (break symbols: 'goes to 110 feet', 'Eocene found 107 ft - 110 ft', 'goes to 80 feet'), so their NMd intervals have no bottom. 5-192 and 5-186 are drawn above the profile and 5-194 starts below it: no land-surface elevation. Hole positions along the section and contacts between holes not recorded (no horizontal scale printed). Map-face drill-hole labels (7-xxx) have no printed locations.
